description: No qualifying in-month gathering was verified in the captured searches. Query records covered early (1–10), middle (11–20) and late (21–31) January in English and Arabic, plus whole-month/local-source searches. This is a bounded open-web result, not evidence no protests occurred.

The planned 11 January petroleum-sector security workers sit-in was reported on 6 January and suspended on 9 January after talks; no execution is shown. The available snippets also do not establish intended simultaneous crowd size.

Search hits for Bidoon/stateless communities, public employees, education, migrant workers, and health did not establish an actual January 2023 public gathering with 50 or more simultaneous attendees and a domestic state-policy demand. Arabic searches returned many stale, out-of-quarter and unrelated records; targeted local searches remain useful if new leads appear.

This was an open-web pass using search queries and local/regional news hits; no LexisNexis archive or systematic daily-issue review was available. Result sets contained numerous historical snippets and parliamentary-session stories rather than street gatherings. Follow any new dated local leads and check January/February continuity only when a qualifying episode is identified.
